# Project & deliverable {.unnumbered}

## Project data

```{r, echo = F}
library(tibble) |> suppressPackageStartupMessages()
library(flextable) |> suppressPackageStartupMessages()

project_data <- tribble(
  ~ "V1",            ~ "V2",
  "Project acronym", "SOILHARMONY",
  "Project name", paste0("Towards a Harmonised pan-European Monitoring",
                         "of Soil Health Descriptors"),
  "Project number",  "101296615",
  "Call topic",      "HORIZON-MISS-2025-05-SOIL-04",
  "Type of action",  "HORIZON-RIA",
  "Lead contractor", "INRAE",
  "Project website", "... coming soon"
)
flextable(project_data) |>
  autofit() |>
  delete_part(part = "header") |>
  theme_box()
```

  "Submission date",     "??",
  "Work package no.",    "WP5",
  "Lead beneficiary",    "EVINBO / CRA-W / ATK",

)
flextable(deliverable_data) |>

## Contributors

```{r, echo=F}

inbo <- "Research Institute Nature and Forest, Flanders (Belgium)"
contributors <- tribble(
  ~ "Name",         ~ "Organization and country",
  "Hans Van Calster", inbo,
  "Ben Serrien",      inbo,
)
flextable(contributors) |>
  autofit() |>
  theme_box()
```

## Revision history

```{r, echo=F}

revision_history <- tribble(
  ~ "Version", ~ "Date",     ~ "Reviewer", ~ "Modifications",
  "V0",        "2026-09-07", "/",          "/"
)
flextable(revision_history) |>
  autofit() |>
  theme_box()
```
